study_identification_part.si4_title: Linking Personalized Brain Atrophy to Schizophrenia Network and Treatment Response

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its aims: to use normative modeling of cortical thickness to derive personalized atrophy maps in schizophrenia and test whether these maps (1) form a disorder-specific functional network and (2) explain individual variation in response to rTMS. It also states the purpose of applying normative modeling (individual-level inference and potential clinical utility).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "The healthy subjects were used to establish normative reference ranges for cortical thickness as a function of age and sex. Then, a schizophrenia patient's personalized atrophy map was computed as vertex-wise deviations from the normative model... [and] their longitudinal symptom changes were adopted to test the clinical utility of the personalized atrophy map."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study builds a new normative model. It reports the final sample size of healthy subjects (n=797) and provides general eligibility bounds (ages 18–45) and exclusion criteria that apply to both groups (e.g., head trauma, substance abuse, focal lesions, excessive motion in rs-fMRI). However, detailed inclusion criteria specific to the healthy reference cohort and explicit counts/reasons for exclusions are not reported.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "This study included 797 healthy adults (18 to 45 years old, 411 females) and 91 schizophrenia patients." ... "The exclusion criteria for both groups were: (1) history of significant head trauma, (2) alcohol or drug abuse, (3) focal brain lesions on T1- or T2-weighted... (4) head motion exceeding 3 mm in translation or 3° in rotation during rs-fMRI scanning..."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and gender are explicitly modeled as covariates in the normative model via a vertex-wise GLM. Data are from a single site, so no multisite harmonization is required.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "We first established a vertex-wise general linear model (GLM) of CT for the healthy subjects using age and gender as covariates."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data source for the reference cohort is clearly described: retrospective selection from the hospital database, with imaging acquired at a single site on a GE 3T scanner (USTC, Hefei).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "The MRI data of 797 healthy subjects and 91 schizophrenia patients (between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2020) were retrospectively selected from our hospital database." ... "Structural and fMRI data were obtained at the University of Science and Technology of China (Hefei, China) with a 3-T scanner (Discovery 750; GE Healthcare...)."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Primary data collection is used, and imaging modality, acquisition parameters, and equipment specifications are provided for T1-weighted and rs-fMRI scans.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "3-T scanner (Discovery 750; GE Healthcare...). High-resolution T1-weighted... (repetition/echo time, 8.16/3.18 ms; flip angle, 12; field of view, 256×256 mm; matrices 256×256; section thickness, 1 mm; voxel size, 1×1×1 mm). Resting-state functional images... (TR/TE, 2400/30 ms; flip angle, 90; FOV, 192×192 mm; 64×64; section thickness, 3 mm; voxel size, 3×3×3 mm; 46 sections; 217 volumes)."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing procedures are described, including software (FreeSurfer v6.0; SPM12; AFNI), key steps (e.g., recon-all steps, smoothing kernels), and quality control (visual inspection and manual edits).
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "Quantitative morphometric analysis was performed using FreeSurfer (version 6.0)... CT was computed... smoothed with an 8 mm FWHM kernel... The entire cortex of each subject was visually inspected, and inaccuracies in segmentation were manually edited." ... "The rs-fMRI data were preprocessed using SPM12 and AFNI... steps: delete first 5 time points; 3dDespike; slice timing; motion correction; co-registration; nuisance regression; DARTEL normalization; 4 mm smoothing."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: For the newly built normative model, no data partitioning strategy (e.g., hold-out, K-fold, or LOOCV) is described. The model is described as a vertex-wise GLM fitted on the healthy cohort without mention of validation on held-out healthy data.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "We first established a vertex-wise general linear model (GLM) of CT for the healthy subjects using age and gender as covariates." (No mention of train/test split or cross-validation).
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: Ji2023.pdf.md — Atrophy Map and Network; Methods — no partitioning described

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: There is no application of the normative model to an independent external healthy dataset. Functional connectivity uses a subgroup of the same healthy cohort.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "resting-state functional MRI ... were acquired for 652 of the 797 healthy subjects." (internal subgroup; no external dataset cited).

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The normative approach is specified as a vertex-wise GLM with age and gender covariates, and the computation of W-scores (z-scores adjusted for covariates) is detailed, including the formula and interpretation.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "We first established a vertex-wise general linear model (GLM) of CT for the healthy subjects using age and gender as covariates... parameters ... were used to calculate a vertex-wise W-score... (a W-score is a z-score adjusted for age and gender) using the formula: W-score = (expected - actual)/RSD..."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: The study does not report quantitative fit or calibration metrics for the normative model (e.g., explained variance, prediction error, or coverage of prediction intervals) on the reference cohort.

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: No data partitioning was performed; per guidance, this item is not applicable when no partitioning is used for a new model.

nm11_reproducibility.reason: Software and versions are specified (FreeSurfer v6.0; SPM12; AFNI), but there is no explicit statement about code, trained model, or data availability beyond general mention of supplementary material.
